decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed plant and machinery due to the enclosure screening them, is considered to preserve the character of the Conservation Area and that of the listed Building. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.2.2, ENV.B.2.5 (Development Affecting the Setting of Listed Building) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of sound attenuation have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Thereafter the scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining residential occupiers.
description: Installation of new plant machinery to block C of existing college roof.
